"""Audit TVFSTEP hardware endpoints and estimate same-take source clock."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib
import numpy as np,soundfile as sf
from scipy import signal,optimize
root=Path.cwd();work=root/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/filter-timing-fix-2026-10-16/hardware-comparison'
x,fs=sf.read(root/'tests/hardware_recordings/1-Audio 0001 [2026-10-16 064504].wav');assert fs==48000
work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
# Fit an80-period separation in bypass only; no filter or envelope timing fit.
bypass=x[fs:13*fs];up=signal.resample_poly(bypass,8,1,window=('kaiser',10.));samples=np.arange(fs,2*fs,3);nominal=4096*fs/44100
ref=up[samples*8]
def err(periods):
 pred=np.interp((samples+periods)*8,np.arange(len(up)),up)
 return np.mean((ref-pred)**2)
grid=np.arange(80*nominal-8,80*nominal+8.01,.1);best=min(grid,key=err);fit=optimize.minimize_scalar(err,bounds=(best-.15,best+.15),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-8});initial_clock_error=100*np.sqrt(err(fit.x)/np.mean(ref*ref));assert initial_clock_error<2,initial_clock_error;period=fit.x/80;sr=4096*fs/period;print('CLOCK',period,sr,flush=True)
points=8192

def fold(y,start,end):
 u=signal.resample_poly(y,8,1,window=('kaiser',10.));starts=np.arange(start*fs,end*fs-period,period)
 v=np.mean([np.interp((a+np.arange(points)*period/points)*8,np.arange(len(u)),u) for a in starts],axis=0)
 return v-v.mean()
source=fold(bypass,1,6);sp=np.fft.rfft(source);k=np.arange(len(sp));sp[k*sr/4096>fs/2]=0;source=np.fft.irfft(sp,n=points)
z=np.exp(-2j*np.pi*k/4096)
def response(word):
 c=(word&~3)/16384;d=85/4096
 return np.fft.irfft(sp*(c*c*z)/(1-(2-c*d-c*c)*z+(1-c*d)*z*z),n=points)
def shift(y,phase):return np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(y)*np.exp(-2j*np.pi*k*phase/4096),n=points)
def fit_phase(actual,pred):
 lag=np.argmax(np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(actual)*np.conj(np.fft.rfft(pred)),n=points))*4096/points
 def error(p):
  v=shift(pred,p);gain=actual@v/(v@v);return np.mean((actual-gain*v)**2)
 f=optimize.minimize_scalar(error,bounds=(lag-3,lag+3),method='bounded');v=shift(pred,f.x);gain=actual@v/(v@v)
 return float(f.x),float(gain),float(np.linalg.norm(actual-gain*v)/np.linalg.norm(actual))
first_clock=sr
last=x[120*fs:132*fs];up=signal.resample_poly(last,8,1,window=('kaiser',10.));ref=up[samples*8];last_grid=np.arange(80*nominal-8,80*nominal+8.01,.1);best=min(last_grid,key=err);last_fit=optimize.minimize_scalar(err,bounds=(best-.15,best+.15),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-8});last_clock=4096*fs/(last_fit.x/80);end_clock_error=100*np.sqrt(err(last_fit.x)/np.mean(ref*ref));assert end_clock_error<2,end_clock_error
print('END CLOCK',last_clock,'difference ppm',(last_clock/first_clock-1)*1e6,flush=True)
from numba import njit
base=root/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work'
native=json.loads((base/'tvfstep-multichannel-2026-10-16/pack/native-validation.json').read_text())
current=json.loads((base/'filter-timing-fix-2026-10-16/pack/native-validation.json').read_text())
ratio=8;rate=sr*ratio;clock=sr/44100;N=round(5*rate);duration=.010844412349537208
excitation=np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(source),n=4096*ratio)*(ratio/2)
@njit
def render(src,phase,gain,offset,scale,wt,targets):
 low=np.zeros(ratio);band=np.zeros(ratio);out=np.empty(N);j=0;c=targets[0];target=c;slope=0.;remaining=0.;dt=clock*scale/rate;period=len(src)
 for i in range(N):
  t=i/rate;u=(t-offset)*clock*scale
  while j+1<len(wt) and wt[j+1]<=u:
   j+=1;target=targets[j];slope=(target-c)/duration;remaining=duration
  if remaining>0:
   inc=min(dt,remaining);c+=slope*inc;remaining-=inc
   if remaining<1e-15:c=target
  pos=(i-phase*ratio)%period;k=int(pos);a=pos-k;v=(1-a)*src[k]+a*src[(k+1)%period];lane=i%ratio
  low[lane]+=c*band[lane];band[lane]+=c*(v-low[lane]-(85/4096)*band[lane]);out[i]=gain*low[lane]
 return out

rows=[];calibrations=[];scales={};sequence=[0,5,6,6,5,5,6,0]
np.savez(work/'source.npz',source=source,period=period,source_rate=sr)
for take in range(2,8):
 direction='up' if sequence[take-1]==5 else 'down';case=native['cases'][5 if direction=='up' else 6];y=x[(1+(take-1)*17)*fs:(13+(take-1)*17)*fs]
 actual=fold(y,9,11);phase,gain,error=fit_phase(actual,response(case['last_word']));phase=(phase+9*sr)%4096
 calibrations.append(dict(take=take,direction=direction,phase=phase,gain=gain,plateau_error_percent=100*error));print('CAL',calibrations[-1],flush=True)
 rawt=np.array([r['seconds'] for r in case['cutoff']]);wv=np.array([r['word'] for r in case['cutoff']]);keep=np.r_[True,np.diff(wv)!=0];targets=(wv[keep]&~3)/16384
 ti=np.arange(round(.5*fs),round(4.8*fs));t=ti/fs;obs=y[ti];train=(np.floor(t/.2).astype(int)%2)==0;test=~train;idx=np.flatnonzero(train)[::16]
 for model in ['historical-targets','current-targets']:
  selected=case if model=='historical-targets' else current['cases'][0 if direction=='up' else 1]
  assert selected['last_word']==case['last_word']
  rawt=np.array([r['seconds'] for r in selected['cutoff']]);wv=np.array([r['word'] for r in selected['cutoff']]);keep=np.r_[True,np.diff(wv)!=0];targets=(wv[keep]&~3)/16384
  wt=(rawt[0]+np.arange(len(rawt))*.020 if model=='uniform20ms' else rawt)[keep]
  fixed=1.0
  def prediction(v):return np.interp(t*rate,np.arange(N),render(excitation,phase,gain,v[0],v[1] if len(v)>1 else fixed,wt,targets))
  def residual(v):return (prediction(v)[idx]-obs[idx])/np.std(obs[idx])
  candidates=[]
  for off in np.arange(.020,.0801,.003):
   v=np.array([off,1.] if model=='time-scale' else [off]);r=residual(v);candidates.append((r@r,v))
  v0=min(candidates,key=lambda q:q[0])[1]
  def jac(v):
   cols=[]
   for j in range(len(v)):
    step=.00002 if j==0 else .00001;a=v.copy();bb=v.copy();a[j]+=step;bb[j]-=step;cols.append((residual(a)-residual(bb))/(2*step))
   return np.array(cols).T
  f=optimize.least_squares(residual,v0,jac=jac,bounds=([-.05,.985],[.15,1.015]) if model=='time-scale' else ([-.05],[.15]),x_scale='jac',max_nfev=50)
  pred=prediction(f.x);scale=f.x[1] if len(f.x)>1 else fixed
  row=dict(take=take,direction=direction,model=model,offset_ms=float(f.x[0]*1000),time_scale=float(scale),training_error_percent=float(100*np.linalg.norm((obs-pred)[train])/np.linalg.norm(obs[train])),evaluation_error_percent=float(100*np.linalg.norm((obs-pred)[test])/np.linalg.norm(obs[test])))
  rows.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
  np.savez(work/f'take{take}-{model}.npz',t=t,observed=obs,predicted=pred)
 scales[direction]=fixed
 (work/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(bypass_period_errors_percent=[initial_clock_error,end_clock_error],source_rate_start=first_clock,source_rate_end=last_clock,source_clock_change_ppm=(last_clock/first_clock-1)*1e6,plateau_calibrations=calibrations,rows=rows,duration_ms=duration*1000,scales_selected_on_first_take=scales,limits=['Baseline slew10.844ms frozen from prior recording.','Source clock from starting bypass; phase/gain from each later9..11s plateau.','Alternating200ms training/evaluation blocks; scale and alignment use training only.','No time scale fit: both schedules use1.0; only constant alignment is fitted on training blocks.','Historical and fresh current-build native target schedules; cross-build/control-phase histories differ, so this is not a controlled isolatedCPU causal comparison. Both use the same frozen10.844ms diagnostic transition law, not a hardware-validated production filter law.','Fractional lane/analog chain model remains approximate.']),indent=2)+'\n')
